description:
This map provides a schematic representation of a coastal lagoon landscape, illustrating various land cover/land use types using a colour-coded legend and numerical codes, likely from a CORINE Land Cover (CLC) related nomenclature. The legend defines six categories:
*   Light blue represents "Lagoon" (coded 8.3.1 Lagoons).
*   Yellow represents "Sand bank" (coded 6.2.1.0 Beaches).
*   Dark olive green represents "Vegetated dunes" (coded 5.1.0 Heathland and moorland).
*   Light beige represents "Arable land" (coded 2.1.1 Arable land).
*   Light grey represents "Cliffs" (coded 6.3.1.1 Bare).
*   Dark blue represents "Sea and ocean" (coded 8.4.2 Coastal waters).

The map depicts a large "8.3.1 Lagoons" (light blue) area separated from "8.4.2 Coastal waters" (dark blue) by a distinct yellow "6.2.1.0 Beaches" (Sand bank) barrier. Inland from this barrier, a dark olive green strip is labelled "5.1.0 Heathland and moorland" (Vegetated dunes). The vast majority of the terrestrial area surrounding the lagoon and coastal features is light beige, designated "2.1.1 Arable land". A light grey area, labelled "6.3.1.1 Bare" (Cliffs), is located along the northern edge of the "8.4.2 Coastal waters". A thin, light blue linear feature, likely a river or stream, enters the "8.4.2 Coastal waters" from the north-east, traversing a yellow "Sand bank" area.
